info.name: Willy's Backend - Bundles API
info.description:
Complete API documentation for the Bundles management system. Bundles are collections of menu items grouped together with a specific price.

## Authentication
All endpoints require JWT authentication with admin role.

## Base URL
`{{base_url}}/api/v1/admin/menu/bundles`

## Bundle Status
- `active`: Bundle is available for customers
- `draft`: Bundle is being prepared (default)
- `archived`: Bundle is no longer available
